capabilities: fold every heading that has no subheading with one command (HS)
toggle all headings of a chosen level (H1 to H6)
fold or unfold one heading level at a time (H- and H+)
set a default fold state applied when a note opens
trigger every action via ribbon icons, commands, or hotkeys
extras: The README states the plugin was developed with AI coding assistance for code generation, testing, and documentation, and that bug reports should include the Obsidian version.
problem: Obsidian's native heading folding works one section at a time, so collapsing a long note down to its outline takes many manual clicks.

relations.evidence: core folding logic directly references and is inspired by the exceptional work done in obsidian-creases

summary: Adds commands and ribbon icons that fold all leaf heading sections, or all headings of a chosen level, turning a long note into a readable outline.
